gradient-3024x4032.heic

A generated horizontal colour gradient (red 0 to 255, green 96, blue 255 to 0), 3024 x 4032 pixels,
HEVC, quality 40, no EXIF, no GPS, no photo, no personal data (CG-SEC-11).
Made on 19/Nov/2026 with pillow-heif 1.8.1 (libheif 1.23.6) and Pillow 12.3.0 from a numpy array; the
tool is used only to make this file and is not a dependency of the repository. The file is our own
output, with the content of a plain gradient, and carries no third-party licence.
It is the HEIC counterpart of "thura-bill.heic 3024 x 4032" of the spec scenario "HEIC becomes JPEG
1920 x 2560" (add-attachments-upload design D5 / task 2.3).
